title: Exactness of external-coefficient sections on one affine rectangle
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}k$, $g:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ scheme morphisms [def-pc-scheme], $U\subset X$ and $V\subset Y$ affine opens. Let $S=(F_1\to F_2\to F_3)$ be short exact [def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence] with all three modules quasi-coherent [pqf-def-coherent], and let $G$ be quasi-coherent on $Y$. On the single rectangle $\operatorname{pr}_1^{-1}U\cap\operatorname{pr}_2^{-1}V$, the sequence of sections of $\operatorname{pr}_1^*F_i\otimes\operatorname{pr}_2^*G$, restricted to $k$, is short exact. Pullback means tensorPullback; the functor in $F$ is tensorPullback(pr1) followed by tensorRight(tensorPullback(pr2)(G)). No compactness, diagonal, cover, cochain or cohomology hypothesis is asserted.

source.place: Tag 0BED, lemma-kunneth, equation-kunneth-on-cech and the short exact coefficient diagram immediately after it; read online at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0BED.

proof.text: Apply picardScalar_affine_sections_exact to S on U to obtain the short exact scalar section complex.

Tensor this complex with the scalar section module of G on V. Every k-vector space is free and hence flat. Mathlib Module.Flat supplies preservation of finite limits by tensorRight; its closed adjunction supplies preservation of finite colimits. ShortExact.map_of_exact therefore gives short exactness of the tensor complex.

Obtain the isomorphism of short complexes from picardExternal_affine_rectangle_comparison and transport short exactness using ShortComplex.shortExact_of_iso. The external coefficient zero-map instance uses the additive tensorPullback adjunction. No exactness remains to prove in this module.

proof_origin.place: Affine scalar exactness, tensor exactness over the field, and transport by the natural rectangle short-complex comparison

theorem picardExternal_affine_rectangle_exact
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    (U : X.Opens) (V : Y.Opens) (hU : IsAffineOpen U) (hV : IsAffineOpen V)
    (S : ShortComplex X.Modules) (hS : S.ShortExact)
    [S.X₁.IsQuasicoherent] [S.X₂.IsQuasicoherent] [S.X₃.IsQuasicoherent]
    (G : Y.Modules) [G.IsQuasicoherent] :
    (S.map (picardExternalCoefficientFunctor f g G ⋙
      picardScalarSectionsFunctor (pullback.fst f g ≫ f)
        (pullback.fst f g ⁻¹ᵁ U ⊓ pullback.snd f g ⁻¹ᵁ V))).ShortExact
